data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded gross releases of prior year reserves totalling $40.3m in 2015 (opening gross claims outstanding $705.7m at 1 Jan 2015). Management attribute the releases to generally favourable claims development, including lower-than-expected natural catastrophe activity during 2015 and easing claims activity in key US liability lines. Releases were reported across divisions (Marine, Political risks & contingency, Property, Reinsurance and Specialty lines).
raw_causal_phrases: Overall, the claims environment has been favourable during 2015, when we have again experienced lower than expected natural catastrophe activity.
The economy in our principal market, the US, continues to rebound from the economic downturn, easing claims activity on the professional liability and management liability books.

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts are reported in the syndicate functional currency (USD). Opening reserves used the 2014 comparative 'Claims outstanding' gross figure from the balance sheet. Prior year development uses the narrative 'released prior year reserves of $40.3m' (explicit gross amount). Mapping of some divisional LOBs to the provided standard LOB list required best-fit approximations (e.g. Political risks & contingency -> 'Aggregate' with low confidence). A gross claims development triangle exists in the Technical Provisions note but is presented primarily as cumulative % development and summary ultimate / outstanding amounts; extracting a full numeric development matrix was ambiguous, so a triangle is not included in structured form below.
